label: Hindbrain/brainstem and cranial nerve development
reason: Hindbrain, pons and brainstem development with branchiomotor/facial/trigeminal nerves; suckling and respiratory control are brainstem functions.

label: Amino acid catabolism and biosynthesis
reason: Aromatic, threonine, histidine, proline and glycine metabolism; pyrimidine catabolism is a minor outlier.

label: Axon guidance via semaphorin and netrin
reason: Semaphorin-plexin, CRMP and netrin repulsion signalling plus axon guidance and nerve branching.

label: Amino sugar/sialic acid glycoconjugate synthesis and lysosomal degradation
reason: N-glycan/UDP-GlcNAc/sialic acid synthesis (CDGs) and lysosomal glycan/ganglioside catabolism linked by shared amino-sugar and sialic acid substrates.

label: Amino acid catabolism incl. phenylalanine/BH4
reason: Aromatic, threonine, histidine, proline amino acid metabolism; BH4 synthesis is the phenylalanine hydroxylase cofactor.

label: Keratinocyte and skin appendage differentiation
reason: Keratinocyte proliferation/differentiation, hair cycle, sebaceous gland and melanocytes are all epidermal biology.

label: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling in muscle
reason: Ryanodine receptor release, SERCA uptake, NCX and Ca2+ control of cardiac/skeletal contraction.

label: Purine nucleotide synthesis, salvage and degradation
reason: De novo IMP/AMP/GMP synthesis, PRPP, purine salvage (HPRT, APRT, ADA, PNP) and catabolism to allantoin.

label: Proteostasis: UPR, heat shock, chaperonin folding
reason: ER UPR arms, integrated stress response kinases, HSF1 heat shock and CCT/TRiC folding all respond to protein misfolding; RHOBTB2 is an outlier.

label: p53-linked apoptosis, necroptosis and cellular senescence
reason: Intrinsic/extrinsic apoptosis, necroptosis and senescence (p16/p14ARF, SASP) are linked as p53/DNA-damage-driven cell fate outcomes.

label: Insulin signalling and GLUT4 glucose uptake
reason: IRS/AKT2 activation, GLUT4 translocation (incl. RHOQ/TC10), glycogen synthesis and adiponectin signalling.

label: Renin-angiotensin blood pressure regulation
reason: Angiotensin generation and signalling, renal sodium and blood volume control; bradykinin/neuropeptide catabolism reflects ACE/peptidase activity.

label: SLC amino acid, peptide and urate transport
reason: Plasma membrane solute carriers for amino acids, oligopeptides, organic anions and urate, many renal aminoaciduria disorders; histamine metabolism is odd.

label: TLR/TNF/NOD NF-kB and MAPK signalling
reason: TAK1, IKK, TRAF6, RIP1 and NIK-mediated NF-kB/JNK/p38 activation downstream of innate and TNFR receptors.

label: cAMP/PKA second messenger signalling
reason: Adenylate cyclase, cAMP synthesis/degradation by PDEs and PKA activation.

label: Methionine/SAM cycle and selenium metabolism
reason: Methionine salvage, SAM/AHCY/MAT1A and selenoamino acid metabolism sharing the sulfur pathway; folate and neural tube closure tie to methyl metabolism.

label: HIV life cycle and AID/APOBEC antibody diversification
reason: Retroviral replication/integration and Ig V(D)J/SHM/CSR linked by APOBEC/AID cytidine deamination and DNA recombination/integration mechanisms.

label: Nephron and glomerulus development
reason: Metanephric tubule, collecting duct, loop of Henle and glomerular mesangium/endothelium development plus filtration.

label: Rho family GTPase signalling and actin
reason: RHO/RAC/CDC42/RND GTPase cycles and effectors (ROCK, PAK, formins, WASP) controlling actin and adhesion.

label: eNOS-NO-cGMP vascular relaxation
reason: eNOS activation/trafficking, NO-cGMP signalling and vascular smooth muscle relaxation.

label: Presynaptic neurotransmitter release
reason: Synaptic vesicle docking, priming, Ca2+-triggered exocytosis and presynaptic modulation across transmitter types.

label: Epithelial/keratinocyte differentiation and wound healing
reason: Keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation, epithelial junctions and re-epithelialisation of wounds.

label: Sulfur/selenium amino acid and choline/carnitine metabolism
reason: Transsulfuration and selenium handling linked to choline/carnitine via methyl-group metabolism (SAM, betaine-homocysteine) and FMO3 trimethylamine oxidation.

label: Antigen presentation by dendritic cells and monocytes
reason: MHC class II/CD1 antigen processing and presentation with DC and monocyte surface signatures.

label: Antiviral type I interferon induction
reason: RIG-I/MDA5, cytosolic DNA and TLR7/8/9-driven IRF3/IRF7 activation and IFN responses to viruses.

label: Glucose and glycogen metabolism
reason: Glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, glycogen synthesis/breakdown, glycogen storage diseases and glucagon/PKA regulation.

label: Neurotrophin p75NTR and TRK signalling
reason: NGF/TRKA and p75NTR survival and death signalling, dependence receptors and downstream effectors.

label: Lipoprotein metabolism and cholesterol transport
reason: Chylomicron/VLDL/LDL/HDL assembly, remodelling and clearance, cholesterol efflux and LXR regulation.

label: mTOR/AKT nutrient and energy sensing
reason: mTORC1/2 regulation by amino acids, AMPK, TSC and AKT, plus PI3K-AKT-mTOR hallmark.

label: TAK1/IKK NF-kB activation in innate signalling
reason: TRAF6/TAK1 and IRAK/RIP1-mediated IKK, JNK and p38 activation downstream of TLRs.

label: Eicosanoid and CYP fatty acid oxidation
reason: Leukotriene, lipoxin, hepoxilin, HETE/EET synthesis via lipoxygenase and P450 omega-hydroxylase/epoxygenase pathways.

label: Myeloid Fc receptor and phagocyte effector immunity
reason: Fc receptor, complement receptor and neutrophil/monocyte effector functions, degranulation and phagocytosis.

label: Gonad, germ cell, placenta and reproductive hormones
reason: Gonad/germ cell development, trophoblast/placentation and gonadotropin/steroid endocrinology linked by the reproductive axis.

label: Peroxisome biogenesis and fatty acid oxidation
reason: Peroxisomal protein import, fission and peroxisomal alpha/beta-oxidation of very long and branched fatty acids.

label: Gi-coupled GPCR inhibition of cAMP
reason: Muscarinic, alpha-2 adrenergic, adenosine and purinergic receptors inhibiting adenylate cyclase.

label: Mitochondrial acyl-CoA and branched-chain catabolism
reason: BCAA catabolism, beta-oxidation, PDH/OGDH/BCKDH complexes, ketone bodies and CoA/biotin/lipoate cofactors in mitochondria.

label: Triglyceride storage and lipid droplet metabolism
reason: Triglyceride synthesis and lipolysis, lipid droplet dynamics, lipophagy and adipocyte biology.

label: SLC transport of metabolic organic anions
reason: Carriers for TCA intermediates, pyruvate, monocarboxylates, carnitine and related transporter deficiencies.

label: Cardiac muscle development and growth
reason: Cardiomyocyte proliferation, differentiation, trabeculation, compaction and hypertrophy.

label: Assorted gene-specific transcriptional regulation
reason: PAX3 targets, CDH1/CDH11/PTEN/PD-L1 transcription and ALK-STAT3 nuclear events share only generic transcription regulation.
